units.title: Occupational Health and Safety for Operator Helper

learning_outcomes.description: Safety Precaution in Workplace

performance_criteria.description: List Personal Protective Equipment and wears • Nose mask • Ear muff • Overall • Hand-gloves • Safety boot • Eye goggles • Reflective jackets • Helmet
Explain relevant safety precautions at: • Construction site • Yard
State company policy for health and safety
Identify safety signs and symbols.

learning_outcomes.description: Occupational Hazards in workplace

performance_criteria.description: Explain potential hazards at: • Site • workplace
State causes of hazards in construction site
Explain how to report hazards to the site supervisor
Explain how to prevent hazards in a workplace

learning_outcomes.description: Accident in workplace

performance_criteria.description: Explain common types of accident in workplace
List causes of accident in the workplace
List basic items in the First Aid Box: • Cotton Wool • Scissors • Iodine • Bandage • Paracetamol • Plaster, etc.
Explain basic First Aid procedures in the event of an accident
Describe how to administer First Aid

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Safe work practices

performance_criteria.description: Wear PPE as per organizational procedures.
Carry out Operator Helper /banksman’s role in line with safe work practices.
Comply with safety procedures when assisting operator.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Communication in workplace

performance_criteria.description: Explain communication in workplace: • peer to peer • Operator to Operator Helper • Operator Helper to operator • Operator Helper to other team members
State the importance of communication in a work environment.
Identify sources of information in workplace

learning_outcomes.description: Understand methods of Communication in workplace

performance_criteria.description: Explain the forms of communication • Verbal (spoken) • Non-verbal (written) • Signs • Signals • Symbols
Explain channels of communication in Workplace
State the means of communication • Phone • Radio • Alarm, etc.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand elements of Communication in workplace

performance_criteria.description: Explain how to receive written information
Explain how to follow verbal information
Describe how to use communication device to pass information

learning_outcomes.description: Communicate to Operator

performance_criteria.description: Use basic signs to communicate with operator.
Use Radio to communicate with operator.
Use phone to communicate with operator
Pass information to operator.

learning_outcomes.description: Know Team Work in Workplace

performance_criteria.description: State the importance of team work in workplace.
Explain relationship in workplace: • Peer to peer • Subordinate to superior
Identify inter-relationships between sections/units in workplace • Surveyors • Operators • Safety Officers, etc.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand how to relate with Superior

performance_criteria.description: Explain the need for good working relationship with superior
list the qualities that promote good working relationship: • Punctuality • Regularity • Honesty • Diligence • Loyalty • Respect • Effective communication, etc.
State the qualities of a good Operator Helper: • Good attitude • Good observer • Safety conscious, etc.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand how to relate with peers

performance_criteria.description: State the importance of good relationship with your peers
Explain the need for mutual respect
List factors that can affect relationship with peers: • Impatience • Dishonesty • Disrespect • Lack of respect for diversity, etc.
State ways to enhance good peer relationship: • Respect privacy • Be reliable and honest • Collaborate with one another • Avoid gossip, etc.

learning_outcomes.description: Positive work relationship with team members

performance_criteria.description: Relate with team members.
Assist Operator and team members.
Communicate information that may affect other workers on the site.

learning_outcomes.description: Earthmoving equipment in construction.

performance_criteria.description: Explain Earthmoving operation in construction.
List equipment used for Earthmoving operation: • Bulldozers • Excavators • Scrapers • Dumpers • Graders • Tippers, etc.
Identify Earthmoving equipment that use attachment: • Excavators • Graders • Bulldozers
State the safety precautions required for the use of earth moving equipment.
Recognize any three of the following earthmoving equipment: • Excavators • Scrapers • Dumpers • Graders • Tippers • Bulldozer

learning_outcomes.description: Equipment used for Hoisting operation.

performance_criteria.description: Explain hoisting operation in construction
List types of equipment used for hoisting operation: • Movable Pulley • Rope and Pulley • Chain Hoist • Mobile Crane • Electric Winch • Tower crane • Derrick Crane • Overhead Gantry Crane
Explain the use of equipment in 2.2 above.
State safety precautions for the use of hoisting equipment.
Recognize Mobile crane and Tower crane

learning_outcomes.description: Equipment used for compaction, concreting and laying operation.

performance_criteria.description: Explain compaction operation in construction
List types of equipment used in compacting and laying operation: • Vibrating Roller • Power Rammer • Paver, etc.
Explain the use of equipment in 3.2 above.
State safety precautions for the use of compacting equipment.
List construction equipment used in concreting: • Concrete batching and mixing plant • Mobile concrete mixer
Explain the use of equipment in 3.5 above
Recognize the following: • Vibrating Roller • Power Rammer • Paver • Mobile Concrete mixer

learning_outcomes.description: Know daily routine checks on Construction Equipment

performance_criteria.description: Explain daily routine Checks
State the importance of daily routine checks
Identify parts of equipment that require daily routine checks.
Explain how to carryout daily routine checks of Construction Equipment

learning_outcomes.description: Carryout daily routine checks of Construction Equipment

performance_criteria.description: Check engine oil level
Check the radiator water level
Check transmission oil level
Check the battery
Check tyres/tracks
Check hose for leakage
Check the diesel level

learning_outcomes.description: Report observations to operator

performance_criteria.description: State the importance of reporting faults/problems to the operator

List common faults/ problems that can be observed from daily routine checks: • Low oil level • Low water level • Low battery • Low diesel • Low tyre pressure • Worn-out bolts/nuts • Damaged electrical wires • Damaged hose, etc.
Explain the safety precautions observed in carryout daily routine checks
Report observation verbally to the operator.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand support services to the operator for equipment before use

performance_criteria.description: Explain the activities of support services for equipment before use: • Daily checks • Report observations • Identify materials/tools required for work.
Perform daily routine checks.
Report observation from daily routine checks.
Select materials/tools required for work.
Apply health and safety precautions while carrying out daily routine checks.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand support services to operator for equipment while in use

performance_criteria.description: Perform ground support to the operator: • Starting equipment • Moving equipment • Positioning equipment • Operating equipment
Use signs or radio to communicate with operator.
Comply with health and safety precautions while performing ground support to the operator.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand support services to operator for equipment after use

performance_criteria.description: Perform ground support to the operator while parking equipment after use.
Perform physical observation of equipment.
Report observation to the operator.
Remove debris on wheel/tracks
Carryout housekeeping for: • Tools • Construction Equipment • Environment • Self
Dispose waste in accordance with environmental procedures.
Comply with health and safety precautions while carrying out support services after equipment use.
